status: draft; frozen proposed cells/schema, not approved for execution; no simulations run
purpose: Propose deterministic pilot/screening/qualification structure. This file makes no accuracy, calibration, runtime, or inference claim.

generator.history_conditioning: Generate post-capture histories conditional on the declared first-capture occasion; the first capture itself contributes no likelihood term.
generator.first_capture_layout: Predetermine first-capture occasions across individuals within each cell and retain that layout in the attempt record.
generator.interval_rule: Generate interval survival as logistic(X_phi beta_phi)^Delta using each cell's literal positive interval vector.
generator.observation_rule: After each transition, capture with logistic(X_p beta_p) if alive; dead is absorbing. Apply cell mask independently as an omitted emission, never as predictor imputation.
generator.administrative_followup: Generate through the declared administrative end even after the last capture; do not truncate at last sighting.
generator.frequency: Simulated individuals have frequency 1. The deterministic parity fixture separately checks integer-frequency replication.
generator.rng: Independent streams use the disjoint stage-index seed formula below; retain actual generated datasets for cross-language fits.

proposed_cells.administrative_end: randomly assigned occasions 4-6 and recorded per individual

pilot.purpose: measure fit runtime and partition failures; disclose estimate before full run

screen.purpose: screen primary and stress cells; retain every attempt and failure

qualification.purpose: separately gated qualification only after screen review and explicit compute approval

attempt_record_schema.retry_policy: No replacement attempts and no extension after interim results. If a generator or implementation defect is found, stop and version a new campaign manifest.

compute.runtime_estimate: not available until the 10-fit pilot; do not launch a larger stage before estimating from that pilot
compute.target: Mac for small pilots, four threads per lane and BLAS one; Totoro for CPU campaigns, total at most 150 cores.

approval_gate: Parent reviews and freezes this draft before small estimated pilots. Runs estimated above three hours require displayed pre-run evidence and user approval. No extra user approval is required for the already-authorized small pilots.
